# rle

rle(s) returns the run-length encoding of s: each maximal run of one character becomes the character followed by the run length in decimal. rle("") == "".

Examples:

- `rle('cccbbxxzzzz') == 'c3b2x2z4'`
- `rle('aaaaabbbzzyyybbbbb') == 'a5b3z2y3b5'`

args.content:
def rle(s: str) -> str:
    """See SPEC.md."""
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        c = s[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and s[j] == c:
            j += 1
        out.append(c)
        out.append(str(j - i))
        i = j
    return "".join(out)
